about_the_game:
Welcome to Reign and Rumble, a local competitive party game (2 to 4 players) where wild stuffed animals come to life in a wacky universe!
Play as the Gorb, creatures as cute as they are eccentric, and battle your friends to collect crowns and become the king of the mini-games!

Get ready to reign… or to rumble!

Dive into the chaos of Reign and Rumble with an explosive lineup of over-the-top mini-games!
Experience a wide variety of unique challenges, mixing reflexes, strategy, and a healthy dose of sabotage. Each mini-game is packed with surprises and laughter, with multiple variants to keep the fun fresh every time you play. Customize your Gorb, adapt your playstyle, and prepare for anything… except boredom!

Stuffed mayhem, wild challenges, total chaos

Each mini-game will push your reflexes, timing, and cunning to the limit. Whether it's skill-based trials, survival modes, or time-based competitions, only the smartest — or luckiest — will come out on top.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics Card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 64-bit / Windows 11, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated Graphics Card
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Welcome to Reign and Rumble, a competitive local party game (2 to 4 players) where wacky plushies come to life in a wild and chaotic universe! Play as the Gorb, adorable yet eccentric creatures, and challenge your friends to win crowns and become the ultimate mini-game champion!
